name: gatk_mills
description: The Mills and 1000 Genomes gold-standard indels of the GATK resource bundle for hg38 (Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg38.vcf.gz), published by the Broad Institute. Known indels for base quality score recalibration, and a truth set for indel variant quality score recalibration.

hg38.naming: UCSC: chr1, chr2, chrX, as in the Broad's Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta. Fits that genome and a UCSC-named GRCh38 analysis set; not an Ensembl or NCBI-named one.
